summary: Every command worked the first time on all six projects; the scan took 0.1 to 3.9 seconds. 5 of 6 matched the expected answer and 1 was partly right. The buyer agent also found real problems, all fixed in v1.0.1: 'unsure' answers were not always treated strictly, the borderline note was not printed, re-running overwrote an edited documentation draft, the pre-fill counted weak evidence, and some scanner signals were noise. The Annex IV drafts started with 3 to 10 of 26 items pre-filled from the code; after the agent completed them, 12 to 21 of 26 had content and the rest needs the team.
